statements: ALTER TABLE "product" ADD COLUMN "_version" INTEGER DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL
steps.subject: table/product/column/_version

statements: CREATE TRIGGER "trg_product_bump_version" AFTER UPDATE ON "product" FOR EACH ROW WHEN NEW._version = OLD._version BEGIN UPDATE "product" SET _version = OLD._version + 1 WHERE rowid = NEW.rowid; END
